cta: Which chip should we zoom into next? Comment
title: How Small Is One Switch Inside an NVIDIA Chip?
description:
What is inside an NVIDIA graphics chip, all the way down to a single switch?
We zoom from the graphics card to the chip, its cores and one switch, in 3D. The chip shown is from NVIDIA's Ada Lovelace generation of GeForce cards.
Sources: NVIDIA (Sep 2022).
Animations are simplified illustrations, not exact to scale.
subject: NVIDIA
